items.title: Tom Lellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 31, 2007
items.q: There’s a funny anecdote that Joe Wilder told me about that.

ctx.x: Yeah, you probably know better than I. But it was “String of Pearls,” and it was just, I loved it as a kid. That was definitely —

There’s a funny anecdote that Joe Wilder told me about that. They were playing “In the Mood” at some T.V. thing or something, and the trumpet player said, “Watch this.” And he played that solo over “In the Mood” right?
